firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently ate chicken goes last. The player to that person’s left goes first.
clarifications: The same first player begins the next day after each player has taken a turn.

sources.title: Flock Together Rulebook

internalEvidence: Sea Cow Games links this PDF from its How To Play page. PDF pages 9–10 were rendered and read; the rule assigns last place to the most recent chicken eater and the first turn to their left-hand neighbor, continuing clockwise each day. Matches inventory BGG 383360. SHA-256: 81c8f052e466b8e8172bd12b107ec4780a0a3b0db5c02687175c475ea3241deb. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the exact opening instruction, game identity and edition against the cited rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The rules do not state a tie procedure if multiple players most recently ate chicken together.
